== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker) (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker)]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=97589 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 97589], [https://theswca.com/imgup/97589-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(80, 130, 655, 925)</code> after applying the source orientation. The crop is rotated 90 degrees for display. Source SHA-256 <code>1aec75a2a58e56565eb6466efeb47f8a0afffb9648359caeea03363f0505cf28</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
